est membre de la Communauté de développe: is a member of the Southern African Development Community (SADC), COMESA (Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa), and the Indian Ocean Commission (IOC), regional free trade organizations that together represent over 600 million potential consumers. Investing in Madagascar provides investors with access—not only to the country's competitive advantages but also to these high-potential free trade zones.In July, Madagascar signed the Tripartite Free Trade Agreement (TFTA), which combines SADC, COMESA, and the East African Community (EAC), covering 57% of Africa's total population
est doté d’un potentiel minier, agricole: It has significant mining, agricultural, energy, and fishing potential. Particularly rich and diverse, this potential is yet to be fully exploited. The uniqueness and richness of its biodiversity—with a biodiversity rate of 90% (ranked #1 in Africa) and the highest endemism rate in the world—also represent a major asset for tourism investments.
L’éligibilité de Madagascar à la Loi sur: Madagascar’s eligibility for the African Growth and Opportunity Act (AGOA) with the United States and the signing of the Economic Partnership Agreement (EPA) with the European Union allow companies in the country to export to these markets duty-free. This is reflected in strong trade dynamics between Madagascar and both partners, with exports to the United States increasing by 12.8% in 2016 and exports to the European Union rising by 44.6% in 2016.
met en œuvre des réformes juridiques, pr: Madagascar has implemented significant legal, procedural, and administrative reforms aimed at facilitating business practices and encouraging both local and foreign investments. By 2016, over 20 reforms had been enacted in areas such as business law, commercial justice, import-export, business startup procedures, credit facilitation, and taxation. Various investment-friendly laws have been passed, including the Free Zones and Companies Act, which allows eligible companies to benefit from exemptions on customs duties and VAT on imports, as well as income tax exemptions for the first 15 years.
